data.name: Info_Canvas_Team_What
data.value: It is the template of agents seen as a graph: the orchestrator, the executors, the judges and your repository. The cables say who distributes, who reviews and where each agent works.

data.name: Info_Canvas_Team_Actions
data.value: Add an executor, a judge or the orchestrator. Choose an agent to change its model, its effort and its folders. Join an agent to a folder of the repository, with the mouse or with «Connect to...».

data.name: Info_Canvas_Layers_What
data.value: The canvas has two layers. «Team» is who works; «Plan» is what is done. The cables of the team are never dependencies of the plan.

data.name: Info_Canvas_Layers_Actions
data.value: Change layer with the two buttons, or with Ctrl+1 and Ctrl+2. Choose an agent to see its tasks in the plan, or a task to see its agent.

data.name: Info_Canvas_Strip_What
data.value: A card per agent, always in view: its state, its model and its bars of context, use and budget. Each bar says where its figure comes from.

data.name: Info_Canvas_Strip_Actions
data.value: Choose a card to see the agent and its tasks. Read the origin of each bar: exact, estimated or not exposed.

data.name: Info_Canvas_Inspector_What
data.value: It shows only what governs the run of the agent. That is its model and effort, its tools, its folders, its memory and its instructions. Changing them changes the template.

data.name: Info_Canvas_Inspector_Actions
data.value: Choose another model, or use the recommended one. Give or take tools: those of high risk ask Windows Hello. Write the instructions of the agent and press «Apply».

data.name: Info_Canvas_Repository_What
data.value: It shows your repository without using the network. You see the branch, the current version and the remotes, without user or password. Also whether there are unsaved changes and the main folders.

data.name: Info_Canvas_Repository_Actions
data.value: Join an agent to a folder so it writes only there. Working in your repository during a run makes the task fail.

data.name: Info_Canvas_Analysis_What
data.value: While you assemble, Agent Studio checks the team and the plan and tells you what can already be known. It does not spend your usage limit. Errors prevent approving the plan.

data.name: Info_Canvas_Analysis_Actions
data.value: Press the button of a finding to fix it with one click. Undo with Ctrl+Z and redo with Ctrl+Y. Ask the orchestrator to review the order, with your OK.

data.name: Info_Canvas_Chat_What
data.value: Write what you want to do and the orchestrator reads it in your project, without writing anything. It proposes requirements, changes to the team, risks and questions. Each message spends your usage limit and asks your OK.

data.name: Info_Canvas_Chat_Actions
data.value: Write a message and give your OK. Copy a draft of a requirement to the editor. Apply a suggestion for the team: it is never applied by itself.
